title: Furniture Industry
description: Comprehensive ERP solutions tailored for furniture manufacturers, optimizing design, production and inventory management while streamlining custom orders and supply chain operations.

infoCards.title: Design Studio
infoCards.description: Integrated design and customization platform for furniture manufacturing with 3D visualization.

infoCards.title: Smart Factory
infoCards.description: End-to-end production and quality control system for furniture manufacturing.

faqData.question: How does the system handle custom orders?
faqData.answer: Our system provides comprehensive custom order management including design specifications, material requirements, cost calculations and production scheduling with real-time status tracking.

faqData.question: What inventory management features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes advanced inventory control with material requirements planning, multi-warehouse management and automated reordering based on production schedules and stock levels.

faqData.question: Can it manage product configurations?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution handles complex product configurations with variant management, bill of materials generation and pricing calculations for different materials and finishes.
